item.title: Broadway Under the Stars - Mamma Mia! — Thu Aug 27, 7:00 PM — Sonoma Valley Field of Dreams
item.description:
The global smash hit is coming to Sonoma for the very first time! Set on a sun-drenched Greek island, Mamma Mia! follows a young bride-to-be on a quest to discover the identity of her father — bringing three very unexpected guests from her mother’s past back into their lives. Fueled by ABBA’s greatest hits (including “Dancing Queen,” “Mamma Mia,” “The Winner Takes It All,” and more), this joyful tale of family, friendship, love, and second chances has captured the hearts of millions worldwide. With its large cast, explosive dance numbers, nonstop humor, and irresistible score, Mamma Mia! promises to be one of the biggest and most unforgettable productions in Transcendence history. Mamma Mia! is presented through special arrangement with Music Theatre International (MTI). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: From Sheep to Loom: Diné Weaving Traditions — Fri Aug 28 — SRJC Multicultural Museum - Santa Rosa Campus
item.description:
For the Diné, weaving is considered a ceremony. Creating a single blanket requires many steps, including shearing the sheep, cleaning, carding, spinning, and dyeing the wool, and then finally weaving. It can take hundreds of hours. This exhibit features rugs from the SRJC Multicultural Museum's collections, featuring award winning woven rugs such as a fine "Burntwater" style rug by the great Nellie Roan and many other examples of Navajo rugs from the 1920s through the 1970s.More information available on the SRJC Multicultural Museum website. (https://museum.santarosa.edu/)
Source: Santa Rosa Junior College

item.title: Josh Flores: Big Feels - Featured August Artist in the Living Room — Fri Aug 28, 9:00 AM — San Geronimo Valley Community Center
item.description:
The San Geronimo Valley Community Center proudly presents the artwork of **Josh Flores** in the Living Room of the Maurice Del Mue Galleries. There will be a reception for the artist on **August 9 from 2 - 4 pm**.
Josh has previously exhibited work in the San Rafael Youth In Arts Program “What About Age?” exhibit at the Marin Civic Center and the “One If By Land, Two if By Sea” show at the Bolinas Art Museum. This is Josh’s first solo exhibition at the Community Center.
**Artist bio:** Josh Flores was born in Lima, Peru and raised in Marin. He appreciates the experience of taking a blank piece of paper and going through the process of making something as a reminder to himself that he is capable of anything. His earliest influence to make art came from watching amateur anime, reading manga and his first art teacher Mr. Powell.

item.title: Ultimate Heirloom Apple Tasting Experience at Gold Ridge Organic Farms — Fri Aug 28, 2:00 PM — Gold Ridge Organic Farms
item.description:
Start with a guided walk through our organic apple orchards, where guests will learn how our trees are grown and what apples and people have in common (hint: no two are alike). Enjoy the expansive views of the rolling hills and farms surrounding our 88-acre property in southwest Sebastopol.
Then, enjoy a side-by-side tasting of four to five hand-picked heirloom apples, paired with local artisan cheeses drizzled with our apple cider syrup and a taste of freshly pressed apple juice.
This is a limited-time experience offered only during harvest season, when our apples are at their peak. Spaces are limited, so we encourage you to book soon and secure your spot for an unforgettable afternoon celebrating the magic of heirloom apples.
Source: Press Democrat

Frank and the Bone Machine — a powerhouse North Bay ensemble celebrating the music of Tom Waits.

Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal.
